substeps.caption: In its slot the tray's plate is held against the dock: mains, Ethernet, compressed air, N2 and chilled water are all live through one coupling.
Before the tray moves: air, N2 and water are shut and vented (CombiTac's couplings must not part under pressure), the tray's UPS takes the load, and the dock pulls back 45 mm.
The extractor pulls the tray out of the slot, across the dock, which is now 20 mm clear.
At the opening an identical dock waits in the bay's side wall. The tray stops against it ...
... the guide pins find the plate's bushings (4 mm of misalignment, CombiTac align), the plate is pressed home, the supplies open: back on mains.
